events.title: Ryan Dahl announces Deno
events.summary: Ryan Dahl unveiled Deno on May 30, 2018 — a secure TypeScript/JavaScript runtime addressing Node.js design regrets.
events.about: Dahl's '10 things I regret about Node.js' talk reframed server JS around permissions, native TypeScript, and explicit security. Deno influenced conversations about runtime design even for teams staying on Node.

narrative.whyChosen: Dahl's Deno talk was a rare public redesign of one's own massively successful project.
narrative.whyImportant: It pushed secure-by-default and TypeScript-first runtimes into mainstream discussion.
narrative.problemSolved: Node's module and security model created footguns Dahl wanted to fix from scratch.

events.title: Adobe acquires Magento
events.summary: Adobe announced on May 21, 2018 that it would acquire Magento Commerce for $1.68 billion — folding open-source e-commerce into its Experience Cloud.
events.about: Magento brought Adobe a PHP e-commerce platform with enterprise B2B features, while Adobe brought Magento CDN, analytics, and marketing automation. The deal signaled that digital experience platforms needed native commerce — not just CMS and DAM.

narrative.whyChosen: Adobe's Magento acquisition merged enterprise CMS and e-commerce under one vendor.
narrative.whyImportant: It accelerated Adobe Commerce Cloud as a Shopify Enterprise competitor.
narrative.problemSolved: Enterprises stitched together separate CMS, analytics, and cart platforms without unified customer data.
